metric_semantics.corrvrr: same-seed paired repairs divided by same-seed B0-positive scanner-eligible prompts
metric_semantics.raw_vrr: one minus the current scanner-positive count divided by the same-seed B0-positive count
metric_semantics.corruption: current scanner-positive outputs among same-seed B0-safe scanner-eligible prompts
metric_semantics.validity: non-whitespace generated output among all 575 prompts
metric_semantics.scanner_skipped: reported separately and never treated as scanner-observed safe
